headline: Fujitsu allowed to bid for Government contracts despite Horizon fallout
summary: Hundreds of subpostmasters were wrongfully convicted of stealing between 1999 and 2015 after failures linked to Fujitsu’s Horizon IT system.

headline: Booz Allen Soared On A Beat, Not A Boom
summary: A cheap, beaten-down stock cleared a low earnings bar while the market and its defense services peers sat still, and that was enough to spark a double-digit jump even as revenue keeps falling.
